name: What should I know about custom kitchen design in older Pasadena and Glendale homes?

mainEntity.name: What should I know about custom kitchen design in older Pasadena and Glendale homes?
mainEntity.text: What should I know about custom kitchen design in older Pasadena and Glendale homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older Pasadena and Glendale homes often create the strongest case for custom kitchen design because standard cabinet and layout solutions do not always fit the architecture. These homes may have unusual room proportions, original details worth preserving, or older building systems that need updating. A custom approach allows the kitchen to respect the home’s character while still adding modern functionality. It also helps solve common problems such as uneven floors, out-of-square corners, limited storage, and outdated utility placement. Homeowners should expect the design process to take field conditions seriously, since older homes are rarely straightforward. The goal is not to erase the home’s age but to make the kitchen feel intentional, functional, and integrated with the rest of the property. In many cases, that means combining custom cabinetry with careful trim details, thoughtful lighting, and upgraded systems behind the walls.
